model: Discrete Markov decay paths, transition-independent full absorption; no fit to a measured nucleus.
frozen_recursion_failure: For a --1n--> stable, frozen formula returns Pi_0(a)=1 and Pi_1(a)=0 because x is never decremented.

markov_memory.without_count_augmented_state: terminal exit of b alone is a 0n step; it cannot encode the earlier 1n without remembering history
markov_memory.boundary: A total neutron count or an equivalent sufficient history must be part of the state or represented by a generating function.

normalization.boundary: Other neutron-producing channels are not beta-delayed even if they contribute to ungated counts.

ikeda_one_neutron.boundary: Single-nucleon test of convention, not a proof of many-body sum rule.

beta_prefactor.boundary: Leading-order illustrative normalization with gV=1; do not equate this constant to tabulated K without matching electroweak and radiative correction conventions.
